_note: Exhaustive audit. spring-petclinic has 49 Java files and one data layer, so this truth set is complete rather than sampled — which is why fix.md chose it as the only repo where recall is measured against everything there is to find.
queriesNow: 1 for the page of owners, then 1 per owner for its pets
queriesAfter: 1, with a join fetch or an @EntityGraph on the finder
why: @OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER) on Owner.pets, reached through the paginated findByLastNameStartingWith, makes Hibernate issue a select per owner; it also cannot paginate in SQL alongside a collection fetch.

queriesNow: 1 per pet for its visits, nested inside the per-owner pet fetch
queriesAfter: 1, batched by @BatchSize or a join fetch
why: @OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER) on Pet.visits compounds the Owner.pets N+1: owners page -> pets per owner -> visits per pet.

queriesNow: 1 per vet for its specialties, across the paginated vet list
why: @ManyToMany(fetch = FetchType.EAGER) on Vet.specialties, read through VetController.findPaginated, issues a select per vet on the page.
